subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 executable action updates as one grouped security-sensitive refresh after a current-base rebase and affected-workflow proof?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but it changes code executed with repository tokens, publishing credentials, security-event permissions, and OpenAI credentials; repository policy and the protected `security` label reserve that acceptance decision for an owner.

options.title: Rebase, verify, and approve
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, rerun the affected workflow gates, and merge if credentialed Codex, Docker, token, and CodeQL paths complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex Action and credential-bearing token or release actions from routine setup and labeling updates for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until the failing aggregate gate and Dependabot rebase-access churn are resolved.

recommendation.title: Rebase, verify, and approve
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, rerun the affected workflow gates, and merge if credentialed Codex, Docker, token, and CodeQL paths complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to release-workflow safeguards and cross-workflow validation in the affected surface.
